title: A missing detail is asked for

anchors.5: Uses ask::human to get the name, waits, then assigns hand and delivers duval@northmoor.example.
anchors.3: Asks for the name in a plain reply so the turn ends and a re-mention is needed, or assigns hand and tells hand to ask.
anchors.1: Picks a name itself, or assigns a unit without a name and reports something anyway.
anchors.4: Uses ask::human and delivers the right address, but with an extra round trip such as mentioning hand twice.

steps.post: @lead please have hand look up a faculty member's email address in the Northmoor directory at http://fixtures/northmoor/static-directory.html and tell me what it is.

checks.text: If ask::human was used, the turn continued after the answer with the same budget (§3.7a).
